Pamagat TL: Patakaran sa Pagpapanatili ng IOI Group
Ringkasan BM:
Tiada penebangan hutan, tiada tanaman baru di tanah gambut, tiada eksploitasi (NDPE).
Hormati hak semua pekerja, termasuk pekerja asing dan kontrak.
Tiada buruh paksa, tiada yuran pengambilan, dan pasport atau gaji tidak ditahan.
Gaji minimum, kerja lebih masa dibayar, dan tempat kerja selamat tanpa gangguan seksual.
Paraquat dan racun WHO Kelas 1A/1B dilarang. Sasaran Sifar Bersih (Net-Zero) menjelang 2040.
Summary EN:
No deforestation, no new planting on peat, no exploitation (NDPE).
Respect the rights of all workers, including migrant and contract workers.
No forced labour, no recruitment fees, and no holding of passports or wages.
Minimum wage, paid overtime, and a safe workplace free from sexual harassment.
Paraquat and WHO Class 1A/1B pesticides are banned. Net-Zero target by 2040.
Buod TL:
Walang pagputol ng kagubatan, walang bagong tanim sa peat, walang pang-aabuso (NDPE).
Igalang ang karapatan ng lahat ng manggagawa, kasama ang migrante at kontraktwal.
Walang sapilitang paggawa, walang recruitment fee, at walang pagpigil sa pasaporte o sahod.
Minimum na sahod, bayad na overtime, at ligtas na trabaho na walang sekswal na panliligalig.
Bawal ang Paraquat at pestisidyong WHO Class 1A/1B. Target ang Net-Zero sa 2040.

Pamagat TL: Patakaran ng Walang Pagsusunog
Ringkasan BM:
Pembakaran terbuka dilarang oleh undang-undang (Akta Kualiti Alam Sekeliling 1974).
Tiada pembukaan tanah gambut dan tiada penebangan hutan.
Pekerja diberi latihan mencegah dan memadam kebakaran.
Kontraktor dan pekebun kecil juga mesti mematuhi polisi ini.
Pelanggaran boleh membawa kepada pemecatan, penamatan kontrak atau tindakan pihak berkuasa.
Summary EN:
Open burning is banned by law (Environmental Quality Act 1974).
No development of peatland and no deforestation.
Workers are trained to prevent and put out fires.
Contractors and smallholders must also follow this policy.
Breaking it can lead to dismissal, contract termination or action by the authorities.
Buod TL:
Bawal ng batas ang pagsusunog sa bukas na lugar (Environmental Quality Act 1974).
Walang paggamit ng peatland at walang pagputol ng kagubatan.
Sinasanay ang mga manggagawa na pigilan at patayin ang sunog.
Dapat ding sumunod ang mga kontratista at maliliit na magsasaka.
Ang paglabag ay maaaring magresulta sa pagkatanggal sa trabaho, pagputol ng kontrata o aksyon ng awtoridad.

Tajuk BM: Polisi Peluang Pekerjaan Sama Rata & Kebebasan Berpersatuan
Title EN: Equal Opportunity Employment & Freedom of Association Policies
Pamagat TL: Patakaran sa Pantay na Oportunidad sa Trabaho at Kalayaan sa Pag-uugnayan
Ringkasan BM:
Semua pekerja dilayan sama rata tanpa mengira jantina, bangsa, kewarganegaraan, agama, umur atau status.
Diskriminasi dalam apa jua bentuk adalah dilarang.
Pekerja bebas menyertai atau menubuhkan kesatuan sekerja dan berunding secara kolektif.
Menyertai kesatuan tidak akan menyebabkan tindakan tatatertib.
Aduan boleh dibuat melalui ECC atau secara tanpa nama melalui e-mel, laman web atau hotline.
Summary EN:
All workers are treated equally, regardless of gender, race, nationality, religion, age or status.
Discrimination of any kind is not allowed.
Workers are free to join or form trade unions and bargain collectively.
Joining a union will not lead to disciplinary action.
Complaints can go through the ECC, or anonymously by email, website or hotline.
Buod TL:
Pantay ang trato sa lahat ng manggagawa anuman ang kasarian, lahi, nasyonalidad, relihiyon, edad o katayuan.
Bawal ang anumang uri ng diskriminasyon.
Malayang sumali o bumuo ng unyon ang mga manggagawa at makipagkasundo nang sama-sama.
Hindi ka paparusahan dahil sa pagsali sa unyon.
Maaaring magreklamo sa ECC, o nang hindi nagpapakilala sa email, website o hotline.

Pamagat TL: Patakaran sa Social Media
Ringkasan BM:
Pekerja boleh guna media sosial, tetapi perlu menjaga nama baik syarikat.
Jangan kongsi maklumat sulit syarikat atau data peribadi orang lain di internet.
Jika ragu-ragu, jangan siarkan. Apa yang dimuat naik akan kekal di internet.
Jangan balas hantaran negatif tentang IOI. Laporkan kepada Jabatan Komunikasi Korporat.
Jangan guna logo IOI sebagai gambar profil. Pelanggaran boleh dikenakan tindakan tatatertib.
Summary EN:
You may use social media, but protect the company's good name.
Do not share company secrets or other people's personal data online.
If in doubt, do not post. What goes online stays online.
Don't reply to negative posts about IOI. Report them to Corporate Communications.
Don't use the IOI logo as a profile photo. Breaking the policy can lead to disciplinary action.
Buod TL:
Maaaring gumamit ng social media, pero ingatan ang magandang pangalan ng kumpanya.
Huwag ibahagi online ang lihim ng kumpanya o personal na datos ng iba.
Kung nag-aalinlangan, huwag i-post. Mananatili online ang anumang na-upload.
Huwag sagutin ang negatibong post tungkol sa IOI. I-report sa Corporate Communications.
Huwag gamitin ang logo ng IOI bilang profile photo. Ang paglabag ay maaaring parusahan.

Tajuk BM: Polisi Keselamatan dan Kesihatan Kumpulan IOI
Title EN: IOI Group Safety and Health Policy
Pamagat TL: Patakaran sa Kaligtasan at Kalusugan ng IOI Group
Ringkasan BM:
Keselamatan, kesihatan dan kesejahteraan pekerja adalah keutamaan.
Terpakai kepada semua pekerja, kontraktor, subkontraktor dan pelawat.
Syarikat menyediakan PPE, latihan, maklumat dan penyeliaan yang sesuai.
Ada prosedur kecemasan dan penilaian risiko untuk semua kerja.
Kesedaran tentang HIV/AIDS, tibi, malaria dan isu kesihatan lain.
Summary EN:
Worker safety, health and well-being are the top priority.
Applies to all employees, contractors, subcontractors and visitors.
The company provides proper PPE, training, information and supervision.
Emergency procedures and risk assessments are in place for all work.
Awareness on HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, malaria and other health issues.
Buod TL:
Pangunahing priyoridad ang kaligtasan, kalusugan at kapakanan ng manggagawa.
Para sa lahat ng empleyado, kontratista, subkontratista at bisita.
Nagbibigay ang kumpanya ng tamang PPE, pagsasanay, impormasyon at superbisyon.
May pamamaraan sa emerhensiya at pagsusuri ng panganib sa lahat ng trabaho.
May kampanya tungkol sa HIV/AIDS, TB, malaria at iba pang isyung pangkalusugan.

Pamagat TL: Patakaran sa Kaligtasan at Kalusugan sa Trabaho
Ringkasan BM:
Patuhi semua undang-undang dan peraturan keselamatan & kesihatan pekerjaan.
Bahaya dikenal pasti dan dinilai, dan kawalan diambil untuk mengurangkan risiko.
Pemandu kenderaan dan pengendali jentera mesti ikut prosedur kerja selamat.
Kemalangan, nyaris kemalangan dan keracunan disiasat untuk elak berulang.
Semua pekerja digalakkan memberi pandangan dan terlibat dalam hal keselamatan.
Summary EN:
Follow all occupational safety and health laws and rules.
Hazards are identified and assessed, and controls are put in place to reduce risk.
Vehicle drivers and machine operators must follow safe operating procedures.
Accidents, near misses and poisonings are investigated to stop them happening again.
All employees are encouraged to give input and take part in safety matters.
Buod TL:
Sundin ang lahat ng batas at patakaran sa kaligtasan at kalusugan sa trabaho.
Tinutukoy at sinusuri ang mga panganib, at may hakbang para mabawasan ang mga ito.
Dapat sundin ng mga drayber at operator ng makina ang ligtas na pamamaraan.
Iniimbestigahan ang aksidente, muntik nang aksidente at pagkalason para hindi maulit.
Hinihikayat ang lahat ng manggagawa na makilahok sa usaping pangkaligtasan.

Pamagat TL: Patakaran sa International Sustainability at Carbon Certification (ISCC)
Ringkasan BM:
Estet dan kilang menghasilkan biojisim secara lestari mengikut sistem ISCC.
Tiada pengeluaran di hutan, kawasan perlindungan atau ekosistem terancam.
Lindungi tanah, air dan udara, dan amalkan Amalan Pertanian Baik.
Hormati hak asasi manusia, hak pekerja dan hak tanah.
Kurangkan pelepasan gas rumah hijau.
Summary EN:
Estates and mills produce biomass sustainably under the ISCC system.
No production on forest, protected areas or endangered ecosystems.
Protect soil, water and air, and follow Good Agricultural Practices.
Respect human rights, labour rights and land rights.
Reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
Buod TL:
Ang estate at mill ay gumagawa ng biomass nang sustainable ayon sa sistemang ISCC.
Walang produksyon sa kagubatan, protektadong lugar o nanganganib na ecosystem.
Protektahan ang lupa, tubig at hangin, at sundin ang Good Agricultural Practices.
Igalang ang karapatang pantao, karapatan ng manggagawa at karapatan sa lupa.
Bawasan ang greenhouse gas emissions.

Pamagat TL: Patakaran sa Whistleblowing (Pag-uulat ng Maling Gawain)
Ringkasan BM:
Laporkan salah laku: penipuan, rasuah, kecurian, gangguan seksual, bahaya keselamatan atau pencemaran.
Boleh lapor tanpa nama. Identiti pelapor dirahsiakan.
Pelapor yang jujur dilindungi daripada tindakan balas.
Laporan palsu atau berniat jahat boleh dikenakan tindakan tatatertib.
Saluran: whistleblowing@ioigroup.com, whistleblowing.ioigroup.com, atau Ketua Unit / HR.
Summary EN:
Report wrongdoing: fraud, bribery, theft, sexual harassment, safety danger or pollution.
You may report without giving your name. Your identity is kept confidential.
Honest reporters are protected from retaliation.
False or malicious reports can lead to disciplinary action.
Channels: whistleblowing@ioigroup.com, whistleblowing.ioigroup.com, or your Head of Unit / HR.
Buod TL:
I-report ang maling gawain: pandaraya, suhol, pagnanakaw, sekswal na panliligalig, panganib o polusyon.
Maaaring mag-report nang hindi nagpapakilala. Kumpidensyal ang iyong pagkakakilanlan.
Protektado laban sa paghihiganti ang tapat na nag-uulat.
Ang pekeng o masamang-loob na report ay maaaring parusahan.
Paraan: whistleblowing@ioigroup.com, whistleblowing.ioigroup.com, o sa Head of Unit / HR.

Pamagat TL: Pahayag ng Patakaran sa Kaligtasan sa Kuryente
Ringkasan BM:
Semua kerja elektrik mesti dibuat dengan selamat dan ikut undang-undang.
Sistem elektrik direka, dipasang dan diselenggara dengan cara yang selamat.
Peralatan perlindungan yang sesuai disediakan.
Pekerja diberi arahan, latihan dan penyeliaan tentang keselamatan elektrik.
Semua pekerja bertanggungjawab melindungi nyawa dan harta syarikat.
Summary EN:
All electrical work must be done safely and follow the law.
Electrical systems are designed, installed and maintained safely.
Proper protective equipment is provided.
Workers get instruction, training and supervision on electrical safety.
Every employee is responsible for protecting lives and company property.
Buod TL:
Dapat ligtas at ayon sa batas ang lahat ng gawaing elektrikal.
Ligtas ang disenyo, pagkakabit at pagmementena ng sistemang elektrikal.
May ibinibigay na tamang kagamitang pamproteksyon.
May instruksyon, pagsasanay at superbisyon sa kaligtasan sa kuryente.
Responsibilidad ng bawat manggagawa na protektahan ang buhay at ari-arian ng kumpanya.

Pamagat TL: Patakaran sa Tubig ng IOI Group
Ringkasan BM:
Gunakan air secara bertanggungjawab dan jangan membazir.
Pastikan racun tidak mengalir ke dalam sungai atau saliran.
Lindungi zon penampan dan rizab sungai di ladang.
Semua pekerja diberi akses kepada air bersih, sanitasi dan kebersihan (WASH).
Kualiti air dan sisa air diuji secara berkala.
Summary EN:
Use water responsibly and do not waste it.
Make sure chemicals do not leach into rivers or drains.
Protect buffer zones and riverbank reserves in the estate.
All workers have access to clean water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH).
Water and wastewater quality is tested regularly.
Buod TL:
Gumamit ng tubig nang responsable at huwag mag-aksaya.
Siguraduhing hindi tumatagas ang kemikal sa ilog o kanal.
Protektahan ang buffer zone at reserba sa tabing-ilog sa estate.
Lahat ng manggagawa ay may access sa malinis na tubig, sanitasyon at kalinisan (WASH).
Regular na sinusuri ang kalidad ng tubig at wastewater.

Pamagat TL: Patakaran sa Pagsisiwalat sa Media ng IOI
Ringkasan BM:
Hanya jurucakap yang diberi kuasa boleh bercakap dengan media bagi pihak IOI.
Pekerja lain tidak boleh menjawab soalan media dalam apa jua keadaan.
Rujuk pertanyaan media kepada Jabatan Komunikasi Korporat Kumpulan.
IOI tidak mengulas khabar angin atau spekulasi.
Pelanggaran boleh dikenakan tindakan tatatertib.
Summary EN:
Only authorised spokespersons may speak to the media for IOI.
Other employees must not answer media questions under any circumstances.
Refer media enquiries to Group Corporate Communications.
IOI does not comment on rumours or speculation.
Breaking this policy can lead to disciplinary action.
Buod TL:
Ang awtorisadong tagapagsalita lamang ang maaaring makipag-usap sa media para sa IOI.
Ang ibang empleyado ay hindi dapat sumagot sa tanong ng media sa anumang sitwasyon.
Ipasa ang tanong ng media sa Group Corporate Communications.
Hindi nagkokomento ang IOI sa tsismis o haka-haka.
Ang paglabag ay maaaring parusahan.

Pamagat TL: Alituntunin sa Kalusugang Reproduktibo
Ringkasan BM:
Pekerja wanita perlu memaklumkan pengurusan jika hamil atau menyusu.
Pekerja hamil dan menyusu dilarang membuat kerja yang melibatkan racun atau kimia. Kerja lain akan diberi.
Ujian kehamilan dengan persetujuan: setiap bulan untuk pengendali racun, setiap 3 bulan untuk pekerja lain.
Pemeriksaan sebelum dan selepas bersalin di klinik (KKIA). Pengangkutan disediakan jika perlu.
Cuti bersalin ikut undang-undang. Pekerja asing tertakluk kepada syarat FOMEMA dan Imigresen.
Summary EN:
Female employees must tell management if they are pregnant or breastfeeding.
Pregnant and breastfeeding employees must not do any chemical work. Other work will be given.
Pregnancy tests with consent: monthly for chemical handlers, every 3 months for other workers.
Check-ups before and after birth at a clinic (KKIA). Transport is provided when needed.
Maternity leave follows the law. Foreign workers are subject to FOMEMA and Immigration rules.
Buod TL:
Dapat ipaalam ng babaeng empleyado sa management kung buntis o nagpapasuso.
Bawal sa buntis at nagpapasuso ang anumang trabahong may kemikal. Bibigyan ng ibang trabaho.
Pregnancy test na may pahintulot: buwan-buwan para sa humahawak ng kemikal, bawat 3 buwan para sa iba.
Check-up bago at pagkatapos manganak sa klinika (KKIA). May transportasyon kung kailangan.
Ang maternity leave ay ayon sa batas. Ang dayuhang manggagawa ay sakop ng patakaran ng FOMEMA at Imigrasyon.

Pamagat TL: Alituntunin sa Pamamahala ng Kapaligiran
Ringkasan BM:
Tiada penebangan hutan dan tiada pembukaan tanah gambut baru.
Sifar pembakaran, termasuk tidak boleh membakar sampah rumah.
Zon penampan sungai: tiada semburan racun, baja atau longgokan pelepah.
Sisa terjadual (minyak terpakai, bekas racun) disimpan di stor berbumbung dan dilupuskan oleh agen berlesen.
Memburu, menangkap atau menjual haiwan liar adalah dilarang.
Summary EN:
No deforestation and no new development on peat.
Zero burning, including no burning of household rubbish.
River buffer zones: no spraying, fertilising or frond stacking.
Scheduled waste (used oil, chemical containers) is kept in a roofed store and disposed of by a licensed agent.
Hunting, catching or selling wild animals is not allowed.
Buod TL:
Walang pagputol ng kagubatan at walang bagong paggamit ng peat.
Bawal magsunog, kasama ang basura ng bahay.
Buffer zone ng ilog: walang pag-spray, pag-abono o pagtatambak ng dahon ng palma.
Ang scheduled waste (gamit na langis, lalagyan ng kemikal) ay itinatago sa bodegang may bubong at itinatapon ng lisensyadong ahente.
Bawal ang pangangaso, panghuhuli o pagbebenta ng hayop-gubat.

Pamagat TL: Alituntunin sa Pamamahala ng Agrochemical
Ringkasan BM:
Racun sangat bahaya (WHO Kelas 1A/1B, termasuk Paraquat) dilarang.
Guna hanya racun yang diluluskan, dan hanya selepas bancian perosak (IPM).
Wajib pakai PPE. Semasa menyembur, berdiri di arah atas angin.
Bekas kosong dibilas 3 kali, ditebuk dan disimpan di stor khas untuk pelupusan.
Selepas menyembur, mandi dan tukar pakaian. Basuh pakaian kotor secara berasingan.
Summary EN:
Highly hazardous chemicals (WHO Class 1A/1B, including Paraquat) are banned.
Use only approved chemicals, and only after a pest census (IPM).
Wear PPE. Stand upwind while spraying.
Empty containers are triple-rinsed, punctured and kept in a special store for disposal.
After spraying, take a bath and change clothes. Wash work clothes separately.
Buod TL:
Bawal ang mapanganib na kemikal (WHO Class 1A/1B, kasama ang Paraquat).
Gumamit lamang ng aprubadong kemikal, at pagkatapos lamang ng pest census (IPM).
Magsuot ng PPE. Pumuwesto sa direksyong salungat sa hangin habang nag-i-spray.
Banlawan nang 3 beses ang walang lamang lalagyan, butasin at itago sa espesyal na bodega.
Pagkatapos mag-spray, maligo at magpalit ng damit. Hiwalay na labhan ang damit pantrabaho.

Tajuk BM: Garis Panduan Menangani Gangguan di Tempat Kerja
Title EN: Guidelines for Handling Harassment at Workplace
Pamagat TL: Alituntunin sa Paghawak ng Panliligalig sa Trabaho
Ringkasan BM:
Semua jenis gangguan, termasuk gangguan seksual, buli, ugutan dan keganasan, tidak dibenarkan.
Gangguan: lapor kepada wakil ECC, Pengerusi ECC atau SLO.
Gangguan seksual: lapor terus kepada Pengerusi Jawatankuasa Wanita (WEC). Kes dirahsiakan.
Jika melibatkan pengurusan, lapor kepada Jabatan Kelestarian Wilayah. Boleh juga guna saluran Whistleblowing.
Lapor dalam 5 hari bekerja. Siasatan awal selesai dalam 30 hari bekerja.
Summary EN:
Any harassment, including sexual harassment, bullying, blackmail and violence, is not tolerated.
Harassment: report to an ECC representative, the ECC Chairman or the SLO.
Sexual harassment: report directly to the Women Empowerment Committee (WEC) Chairperson. Cases are kept confidential.
If management is involved, report to the Regional Sustainability Department. The Whistleblowing channel can also be used.
Report within 5 working days. The first investigation is finished within 30 working days.
Buod TL:
Hindi pinahihintulutan ang anumang panliligalig, kasama ang sekswal na panliligalig, pambu-bully, pananakot at karahasan.
Panliligalig: i-report sa kinatawan ng ECC, sa ECC Chairman o sa SLO.
Sekswal na panliligalig: i-report direkta sa Chairperson ng Women Empowerment Committee (WEC). Kumpidensyal ang kaso.
Kung may kinalaman ang management, i-report sa Regional Sustainability Department. Maaari ring gamitin ang Whistleblowing.
Mag-report sa loob ng 5 araw ng trabaho. Tapos ang unang imbestigasyon sa loob ng 30 araw ng trabaho.

Tajuk BM: Garis Panduan Perlindungan & Pengurusan Tanah Gambut
Pamagat TL: Alituntunin sa Proteksyon at Pamamahala ng Peatland
Ringkasan BM:
Tiada pembukaan baru di tanah gambut.
Kawasan gambut dipetakan, dilindungi dan dipulihkan jika rosak.
Paras air dijaga pada 40–60 cm dari permukaan tanah.
Pencegahan kebakaran: pemantauan titik panas dan rondaan.
Pekerja, pembekal dan komuniti diberi latihan tentang kepentingan tanah gambut.
Summary EN:
No new development on peatland.
Peat areas are mapped, protected and restored if damaged.
The water level is kept at 40–60 cm below the ground surface.
Fire prevention: hotspot monitoring and patrols.
Workers, suppliers and communities are trained on why peatland matters.
Buod TL:
Walang bagong paggamit ng peatland.
Minamapa, pinoprotektahan at inaayos ang nasirang peat area.
Pinapanatili ang lebel ng tubig sa 40–60 cm mula sa ibabaw ng lupa.
Pag-iwas sa sunog: pagbabantay ng hotspot at pagpapatrolya.
Sinasanay ang manggagawa, supplier at komunidad tungkol sa kahalagahan ng peatland.

Pamagat TL: Alituntunin sa Responsableng Pagkuha
Ringkasan BM:
Semua pembekal minyak sawit mesti mematuhi NDPE: tiada penebangan hutan, tiada tanah gambut baru, tiada eksploitasi.
Minyak sawit dapat dikesan sehingga ke kilang pembekal.
Pembekal baru disemak dahulu sebelum kontrak ditandatangani.
Jika pembekal membuka hutan atau tanah gambut, mereka mesti berhenti segera atau urus niaga dihentikan.
Aduan terhadap pembekal disiasat dan kemajuannya diterbitkan di laman web IOI.
Summary EN:
All palm oil suppliers must follow NDPE: no deforestation, no new peat, no exploitation.
Palm oil is traceable back to the supplying mill.
New suppliers are checked before any contract is signed.
If a supplier clears forest or peat, they must stop at once or trade is stopped.
Complaints about suppliers are investigated and progress is published on the IOI website.
Buod TL:
Lahat ng supplier ng palm oil ay dapat sumunod sa NDPE: walang pagputol ng gubat, walang bagong peat, walang pang-aabuso.
Natutunton ang palm oil hanggang sa mill na pinagmulan.
Sinusuri muna ang bagong supplier bago pumirma ng kontrata.
Kung naglinis ng gubat o peat ang supplier, dapat itigil agad o ititigil ang negosyo.
Iniimbestigahan ang reklamo laban sa supplier at inilalathala ang progreso sa website ng IOI.

Title EN: Guideline to Plant Your Own Food
Pamagat TL: Alituntunin sa Pagtatanim ng Sariling Pagkain
Ringkasan BM:
Pekerja digalakkan menanam sayur dan buah di kawasan rumah untuk jimat kos.
Dapatkan kelulusan pengurusan jika mahu menanam di luar kawasan rumah.
Tanam sekurang-kurangnya 0.5 m dari longkang dan jangan halang laluan.
Dilarang menanam di rizab sungai, zon penampan hutan, kawasan HCV, tanah gambut atau ladang sawit.
Dilarang guna racun terhad, membakar, menggunakan bekas racun sebagai pasu, atau menanam pokok besar.
Summary EN:
Workers are encouraged to grow vegetables and fruit around their houses to save money.
Get management approval to plant outside the house compound.
Plant at least 0.5 m from drains and don't block walkways.
No planting in river reserves, forest buffer zones, HCV areas, peat or the oil palm field.
Do not use restricted chemicals, burn, reuse chemical containers as pots, or plant big trees.
Buod TL:
Hinihikayat ang manggagawa na magtanim ng gulay at prutas sa paligid ng bahay para makatipid.
Kumuha ng pahintulot ng management kung magtatanim sa labas ng bakuran.
Magtanim nang hindi bababa sa 0.5 m mula sa kanal at huwag harangan ang daanan.
Bawal magtanim sa reserba ng ilog, buffer zone ng gubat, HCV area, peat o taniman ng palma.
Bawal ang restricted na kemikal, pagsusunog, paggamit ng lalagyan ng kemikal bilang paso, o malalaking puno.

Tajuk BM: Garis Panduan Pelaksanaan Jawatankuasa Pemerkasaan Wanita
Title EN: Guideline for Implementation of Women Empowerment Committee
Pamagat TL: Alituntunin sa Pagpapatupad ng Komite sa Pagpapalakas ng Kababaihan
Ringkasan BM:
WEC ialah jawatankuasa khas untuk pekerja wanita. Ahlinya wanita sahaja.
Tempat untuk membincangkan isu wanita: gangguan seksual, keganasan, diskriminasi dan kebajikan.
WEC mengurus aduan gangguan seksual secara sulit.
Mesyuarat sekurang-kurangnya 2 kali setahun. Notis ditampal seminggu lebih awal.
Aduan juga boleh dibuat melalui Buku Hijau, ECC atau Hotline 019 612 9101 (WhatsApp/SMS).
Summary EN:
The WEC is a committee for women employees. Members are women only.
A place to raise women's issues: sexual harassment, violence, discrimination and welfare.
The WEC handles sexual harassment complaints in confidence.
Meetings are held at least twice a year, with notice posted one week before.
Complaints can also go through the Green Book, ECC or Hotline 019 612 9101 (WhatsApp/SMS).
Buod TL:
Ang WEC ay komite para sa kababaihang empleyado. Babae lamang ang miyembro.
Lugar para ilabas ang isyu ng kababaihan: sekswal na panliligalig, karahasan, diskriminasyon at kapakanan.
Kumpidensyal na hinahawakan ng WEC ang reklamo sa sekswal na panliligalig.
May pulong dalawang beses man lang sa isang taon. Ipapaskil ang abiso isang linggo bago.
Maaari ring magreklamo sa Green Book, ECC o Hotline 019 612 9101 (WhatsApp/SMS).

Tajuk BM: Garis Panduan Gaji Minimum dan Gaji Cuti
Title EN: Guideline for Minimum Wage and Leave Pay
Pamagat TL: Alituntunin sa Minimum na Sahod at Bayad sa Bakasyon
Ringkasan BM:
Semua pekerja dibayar sekurang-kurangnya gaji minimum untuk waktu kerja biasa (8 jam, dalam tempoh 10 jam).
Gaji minimum tetap dibayar walaupun tugas tidak siap, asalkan pekerja bekerja penuh waktu biasa.
Kerja lebih masa adalah pilihan. Pekerja boleh terima atau tolak.
Cuti sakit: 14 hari (bawah 2 tahun), 18 hari (2–5 tahun), 22 hari (lebih 5 tahun). Cuti hospital sehingga 60 hari.
Tiada gaji minimum jika ponteng, lari semasa waktu kerja, atau cuti tanpa gaji.
Summary EN:
All workers get at least the minimum wage for normal hours (8 hours, spread over 10 hours).
Minimum wage is still paid if a task isn't finished, as long as the worker works the full normal hours.
Overtime is optional. Workers may accept or refuse it.
Sick leave: 14 days (under 2 years), 18 days (2–5 years), 22 days (over 5 years). Hospital leave up to 60 days.
No minimum wage for absence, leaving during work hours, or unpaid leave.
Buod TL:
Lahat ng manggagawa ay may minimum na sahod para sa normal na oras (8 oras, sa loob ng 10 oras).
Bayad pa rin ang minimum na sahod kahit hindi natapos ang gawain, basta buong oras kang nagtrabaho.
Boluntaryo ang overtime. Maaaring tanggapin o tanggihan.
Sick leave: 14 araw (wala pang 2 taon), 18 araw (2–5 taon), 22 araw (higit 5 taon). Hospital leave hanggang 60 araw.
Walang minimum na sahod kung absent, umalis habang oras ng trabaho, o naka-unpaid leave.

Tajuk BM: SOP Gaji Minimum Pekerja Ladang/Am dan Penuai
Title EN: SOP on Minimum Wages for Estate Field/General Workers and Harvesters
Pamagat TL: SOP sa Minimum na Sahod para sa mga Manggagawa sa Estate at Harvester
Ringkasan BM:
Pekerja harian dibayar sekurang-kurangnya kadar gaji minimum harian mengikut Perintah Gaji Minimum terkini.
Kerja dikira ikut kadar borong (piece rate). Jika hasil lebih tinggi, gaji pun lebih tinggi.
Jika gaji kurang daripada minimum kerana pekerja baru, sakit, hasil rendah atau hujan, estet boleh bayar gaji minimum.
Ponteng atau sengaja tidak siapkan kerja tanpa sebab boleh dikenakan tindakan tatatertib.
Tiada kerja pada hari rehat dan cuti umum kecuali dengan kelulusan Ketua Wilayah.
Summary EN:
Daily-rated workers get at least the daily minimum wage under the latest Minimum Wages Order.
Work is paid by piece rate. If you produce more, you earn more.
If pay falls below minimum because of new-worker training, sickness, low crop or rain, the estate may pay the minimum.
Absence or deliberately not finishing work without reason can lead to disciplinary action.
No work on rest days or public holidays unless approved by the Regional Head.
Buod TL:
Ang daily-rated na manggagawa ay may minimum na sahod kada araw ayon sa pinakabagong Minimum Wages Order.
Binabayaran ayon sa piece rate. Kung mas marami ang nagawa mo, mas malaki ang sahod.
Kung kulang ang sahod dahil bagong manggagawa, may sakit, mababang ani o umuulan, maaaring ibigay ang minimum.
Ang pag-absent o sadyang hindi pagtapos ng trabaho nang walang dahilan ay maaaring parusahan.
Walang trabaho sa rest day at public holiday maliban kung aprubado ng Regional Head.

Tajuk BM: Garis Panduan Penyediaan Kemudahan Asas kepada Pekerja
Title EN: Guideline for Providing Basic Amenities to Workers
Pamagat TL: Alituntunin sa Pagbibigay ng Pangunahing Pasilidad sa mga Manggagawa
Ringkasan BM:
Setiap pekerja diberi katil bujang dan tilam sekurang-kurangnya 4 inci tebal, percuma.
Setiap rumah ada almari, lampu yang cukup, almari makanan (meat safe) dan dapur gas 2 tungku.
Laporkan barang rosak melalui Rekod Kerosakan Rumah, Buku Hijau atau IOI Mesra. Dibaiki dalam 5 hari bekerja.
Pemeriksaan rumah dibuat setiap suku tahun.
Pekerja perlu menjaga harta syarikat dan melaporkan kecurian atau kerosakan.
Summary EN:
Each worker gets a single bed and a mattress at least 4 inches thick, free of charge.
Each house has a cupboard, enough lighting, a meat safe and a 2-burner gas stove.
Report damaged items through the House Repair Record, Green Book or IOI Mesra. Fixed within 5 working days.
Houses are inspected every quarter.
Workers must take care of company property and report theft or damage.
Buod TL:
Bawat manggagawa ay may libreng single na kama at kutson na hindi bababa sa 4 na pulgada ang kapal.
Bawat bahay ay may aparador, sapat na ilaw, meat safe at gas stove na may 2 burner.
I-report ang sirang gamit sa House Repair Record, Green Book o IOI Mesra. Aayusin sa loob ng 5 araw ng trabaho.
Sinusuri ang mga bahay bawat tatlong buwan.
Dapat ingatan ng manggagawa ang ari-arian ng kumpanya at i-report ang nakaw o sira.

Pamagat TL: Alituntunin sa Pamamahala ng Sunog
Ringkasan BM:
Peringkat 1, Pencegahan: penilaian risiko kebakaran, rondaan dan pemantauan titik panas.
Peringkat 2, Kecemasan: laporkan kebakaran segera. Pasukan khas memadam api dengan kerjasama pihak berkuasa dan komuniti.
Peringkat 3, Selepas kebakaran: punca kebakaran dianalisis dan pelan tindakan dibuat.
Pekerja dilatih dan peralatan memadam api disediakan.
Summary EN:
Stage 1, Prevention: fire risk assessment, patrols and hotspot monitoring.
Stage 2, Emergency: report fires immediately. A core team fights the fire with the authorities and community.
Stage 3, After the fire: the cause is analysed and an action plan is made.
Workers are trained and firefighting equipment is provided.
Buod TL:
Yugto 1, Pag-iwas: pagsusuri ng panganib ng sunog, pagpapatrolya at pagbabantay ng hotspot.
Yugto 2, Emerhensiya: i-report agad ang sunog. May pangunahing koponan na lalaban sa sunog kasama ang awtoridad at komunidad.
Yugto 3, Pagkatapos ng sunog: sinusuri ang sanhi at gumagawa ng plano.
Sinasanay ang mga manggagawa at may kagamitan sa pagpatay ng sunog.

Title EN: Guideline for Hair Cut Hairstyle Initiative
Pamagat TL: Alituntunin sa Inisyatiba ng Gupit ng Buhok
Ringkasan BM:
Inisiatif sukarela di bawah Jawatankuasa Wanita (WEC) untuk perkhidmatan gunting rambut di estet.
Penggunting rambut perlu mendaftar dengan Pengerusi WEC.
Perkhidmatan tidak boleh dibuat semasa waktu kerja. Harga mesti berpatutan.
Peralatan dan tempat mesti bersih dan dibasmi kuman.
Dilarang: tindik, potong bulu hidung dan urutan.
Summary EN:
A voluntary initiative under the Women Empowerment Committee (WEC) for haircut services on the estate.
Hairstylists must register with the WEC Chairperson.
No service during working hours. Prices must be fair.
Tools and the work area must be kept clean and disinfected.
Not allowed: piercing, nose-hair trimming and massage.
Buod TL:
Boluntaryong inisyatiba ng Women Empowerment Committee (WEC) para sa gupit sa estate.
Dapat magparehistro ang manggugupit sa WEC Chairperson.
Walang serbisyo habang oras ng trabaho. Dapat makatwiran ang presyo.
Dapat malinis at may disinfectant ang gamit at lugar.
Bawal: pagbubutas (piercing), paggupit ng balahibo sa ilong at masahe.

Pamagat TL: Alituntunin sa Beripikasyon ng Trabaho ng Manggagawa
Ringkasan BM:
Pekerja berhak menyemak rekod kerja dan kehadiran sendiri supaya gaji betul.
Laporan Kerja dan Kehadiran dijana daripada sistem EPMS setiap hari.
Kerja lebih masa direkod dengan masa masuk dan keluar.
Kadar kerja borong (piece rate) dipaparkan di papan kenyataan.
Pekerja baru diberi latihan tentang hak ini semasa induksi.
Summary EN:
Workers have the right to check their own work and attendance records so pay is correct.
The Work Done and Attendance Report is generated daily from the EPMS system.
Overtime is recorded with time-in and time-out.
Piece rates are displayed on the notice board.
New workers are trained on this right during induction.
Buod TL:
May karapatan ang manggagawa na suriin ang sariling rekord ng trabaho at attendance para tama ang sahod.
Ang Work Done and Attendance Report ay galing araw-araw sa sistemang EPMS.
Itinatala ang overtime na may time-in at time-out.
Nakapaskil sa notice board ang piece rate.
Sinasanay ang bagong manggagawa tungkol sa karapatang ito sa induction.

Tajuk BM: Garis Panduan Peningkatan Biodiversiti dan Ekosistem
Pamagat TL: Alituntunin sa Pagpapahusay ng Biodiversity at Ecosystem
Ringkasan BM:
Lindungi kawasan HCV dan hidupan liar yang jarang ditemui, terancam atau hampir pupus.
Memburu dan memerangkap spesies terancam adalah dilarang sama sekali.
Kawasan pemuliharaan dikenal pasti, dipetakan dan dipantau setiap tahun.
Ada pelan krisis untuk konflik manusia–haiwan liar (contohnya gajah).
Zon penampan dan kawasan rosak dipulihkan dengan menanam pokok asli.
Summary EN:
Protect HCV areas and rare, threatened or endangered wildlife.
Hunting and trapping of protected species is strictly banned.
Conservation areas are identified, mapped and monitored every year.
There is a crisis plan for human–wildlife conflict (for example, elephants).
Buffer zones and damaged areas are restored by planting native trees.
Buod TL:
Protektahan ang HCV area at bihira, nanganganib o halos maubos na hayop-gubat.
Mahigpit na bawal ang pangangaso at pag-trap ng protektadong hayop.
Tinutukoy, minamapa at binabantayan taon-taon ang conservation area.
May plano sa krisis para sa salungatan ng tao at hayop-gubat (halimbawa, elepante).
Inaayos ang buffer zone at sirang lugar sa pagtatanim ng katutubong puno.

Tajuk BM: Garis Panduan Pengendalian Pasport Pekerja Asing
Pamagat TL: Alituntunin sa Paghawak ng Pasaporte ng Dayuhang Manggagawa
Ringkasan BM:
Syarikat tidak akan menyimpan pasport pekerja tanpa kebenaran.
Pilihan A: pekerja simpan pasport sendiri. Pilihan B: simpan dalam loker berpusat syarikat atas permintaan pekerja.
Tandatangan dan cap jari diperlukan pada borang pengakuan.
Serahkan pasport sekurang-kurangnya 3 bulan sebelum permit kerja tamat untuk pembaharuan.
Kos pasport hilang atau denda lewat ditanggung oleh pekerja.
Summary EN:
The company will not keep workers' passports without permission.
Option A: keep your own passport. Option B: keep it in the company's central locker, if you ask.
You sign and give your thumbprint on an acknowledgement form.
Hand in your passport at least 3 months before your work permit expires, for renewal.
The cost of a lost passport or late-renewal fines is paid by the worker.
Buod TL:
Hindi itatago ng kumpanya ang pasaporte ng manggagawa nang walang pahintulot.
Opsyon A: ikaw ang magtatago ng pasaporte. Opsyon B: itago sa locker ng kumpanya kung hihilingin mo.
Pipirma ka at maglalagay ng thumbprint sa acknowledgement form.
Ibigay ang pasaporte 3 buwan man lang bago mag-expire ang work permit, para sa renewal.
Ang manggagawa ang magbabayad kung mawala ang pasaporte o may multa sa huling renewal.

Pamagat TL: Pamamaraan sa Hinaing/Reklamo ng mga Empleyado
Ringkasan BM:
Buat aduan kepada Pegawai Perhubungan Sosial (SLO) dalam 5 hari bekerja. Penterjemah disediakan jika perlu.
Semua aduan direkod dalam Buku Aduan (Buku Hijau).
Aduan disiasat dengan adil, dan pengadu tidak akan diancam atau dikenakan tindakan balas.
Jika tidak puas hati, aduan boleh dibuka semula atau dibawa ke peringkat lebih tinggi.
Saluran lain: aplikasi IOI Mesra (ada Tagalog), Hotline/WhatsApp +6019 612 9101, grievance@ioigroup.com.
Summary EN:
Lodge a complaint with the Social Liaison Officer (SLO) within 5 working days. A translator is available if needed.
All complaints are recorded in the Grievance Book (Green Book).
Complaints are investigated fairly, with no threats or retaliation against the complainant.
If you are not satisfied, the complaint can be re-opened or taken to a higher level.
Other channels: IOI Mesra app (has Tagalog), Hotline/WhatsApp +6019 612 9101, grievance@ioigroup.com.
Buod TL:
Magreklamo sa Social Liaison Officer (SLO) sa loob ng 5 araw ng trabaho. May tagasalin kung kailangan.
Lahat ng reklamo ay itinatala sa Grievance Book (Green Book).
Patas ang imbestigasyon, at walang pananakot o paghihiganti sa nagreklamo.
Kung hindi kuntento, maaaring buksan muli ang reklamo o iakyat sa mas mataas na antas.
Iba pang paraan: IOI Mesra app (may Tagalog), Hotline/WhatsApp +6019 612 9101, grievance@ioigroup.com.

Pamagat TL: Alituntunin sa Komunikasyon sa Krisis ng IOI
Ringkasan BM:
Semua kecemasan atau krisis mesti dilaporkan segera kepada Ketua Komunikasi Wilayah dan Komunikasi Korporat Kumpulan.
Ketua Unit atau Ketua Jabatan menjadi jurucakap. Untuk krisis besar, pengurusan tertinggi mengambil alih.
Semua pertanyaan media dirujuk kepada jurucakap yang ditetapkan.
Simpan log semua panggilan dan e-mel daripada media.
Krisis sederhana: kenyataan media pertama dikeluarkan dalam 24 jam.
Summary EN:
Report any emergency or crisis immediately to the Regional Communications Head and Group Corporate Communications.
The Head of Unit or Department is the spokesperson. For big crises, top management takes over.
All media questions go to the appointed spokesperson.
Keep a log of all media calls and emails.
Medium-level crisis: the first press statement is issued within 24 hours.
Buod TL:
I-report agad ang anumang emerhensiya o krisis sa Regional Communications Head at Group Corporate Communications.
Ang Head ng Unit o Departamento ang tagapagsalita. Sa malaking krisis, ang top management ang hahawak.
Lahat ng tanong ng media ay ipapasa sa itinalagang tagapagsalita.
Itala ang lahat ng tawag at email mula sa media.
Katamtamang krisis: ilalabas ang unang press statement sa loob ng 24 oras.

Pamagat TL: Alituntunin sa Paghawak ng Media ng IOI
Ringkasan BM:
Jika wartawan menelefon: bersopan, catat nama, organisasi dan soalan, kemudian rujuk kepada Komunikasi Korporat.
Jangan bercakap 'off the record'.
Wartawan datang tanpa notis: panggil Pengurus. Tiada gambar tanpa kelulusan pengurusan.
Jangan terus bersetuju dengan permintaan lawatan media ke estet. Rujuk dahulu.
Dalam temu bual: nyatakan fakta sahaja dan jangan beri pendapat peribadi.
Summary EN:
If a reporter calls: be polite, note their name, organisation and question, then refer to Corporate Communications.
Never speak 'off the record'.
Reporter turns up unannounced: call the Manager. No photos without management approval.
Don't agree straight away to a media visit to the estate. Refer it first.
In interviews: give facts only and no personal opinions.
Buod TL:
Kung tumawag ang reporter: maging magalang, itala ang pangalan, organisasyon at tanong, saka ipasa sa Corporate Communications.
Huwag magsalita nang 'off the record'.
Kung dumating ang reporter nang walang abiso: tawagin ang Manager. Walang litrato nang walang pahintulot.
Huwag agad pumayag sa pagbisita ng media sa estate. Ipasa muna.
Sa interview: katotohanan lamang at walang personal na opinyon.

Title EN: Code of Business Conduct and Ethics
Pamagat TL: Kodigo ng Asal at Etika sa Negosyo
Ringkasan BM:
Integriti adalah nilai teras: berurusan dengan adil dan jujur.
Hormati rakan sekerja. Gangguan, diskriminasi, keganasan dan membawa senjata tidak dibenarkan.
Jangan terima rasuah, sogokan atau hadiah berlebihan. Isytihar konflik kepentingan.
Jaga harta dan maklumat sulit syarikat. Laporkan kecurian atau salah guna.
Melanggar kod ini boleh membawa kepada pemecatan atau tindakan undang-undang.
Summary EN:
Integrity is the core value: deal fairly and honestly.
Respect colleagues. Harassment, discrimination, violence and bringing weapons are not allowed.
Do not accept bribes, kickbacks or excessive gifts. Declare any conflict of interest.
Protect company property and confidential information. Report theft or misuse.
Breaking this code can lead to dismissal or legal action.
Buod TL:
Integridad ang pangunahing pagpapahalaga: maging patas at tapat.
Igalang ang kapwa manggagawa. Bawal ang panliligalig, diskriminasyon, karahasan at pagdadala ng armas.
Huwag tumanggap ng suhol, kickback o sobrang regalo. Ideklara ang conflict of interest.
Ingatan ang ari-arian at kumpidensyal na impormasyon ng kumpanya. I-report ang nakaw o maling paggamit.
Ang paglabag ay maaaring magresulta sa pagkatanggal sa trabaho o kaso.

Tajuk BM: Kod Etika Pengambilan Beretika & Pekerjaan Bertanggungjawab
Title EN: Code of Conduct on Ethical Recruitment & Responsible Employment
Pamagat TL: Kodigo ng Asal sa Etikal na Pag-recruit at Responsableng Pagtatrabaho
Ringkasan BM:
Tiada yuran pengambilan. Pekerja tidak perlu bayar apa-apa untuk mendapatkan kerja.
Kontrak diterangkan dan ditandatangani dalam bahasa ibunda pekerja.
Pekerja menyimpan pasport sendiri, dan bebas keluar dari estet pada hari cuti.
Tiada buruh paksa, buruh kanak-kanak, ancaman, ugutan atau penahanan gaji.
Pekerja boleh berhenti ikut kontrak. Tambang pulang ditanggung syarikat selepas tamat kontrak.
Summary EN:
No recruitment fees. Workers pay nothing to get the job.
Contracts are explained and signed in the worker's own language.
Workers keep their own passports and are free to leave the estate on rest days.
No forced labour, child labour, threats, intimidation or withholding of wages.
Workers may resign under their contract. The company pays the flight home when the contract ends.
Buod TL:
Walang recruitment fee. Walang babayaran ang manggagawa para makuha ang trabaho.
Ipinapaliwanag at pinipirmahan ang kontrata sa sariling wika ng manggagawa.
Ang manggagawa ang may hawak ng sariling pasaporte at malayang lumabas ng estate sa araw ng pahinga.
Walang sapilitang paggawa, child labor, pananakot o pagpigil sa sahod.
Maaaring mag-resign ayon sa kontrata. Sagot ng kumpanya ang pamasahe pauwi pagkatapos ng kontrata.
